text: You sign off on a list that is proposed to you, rather than building it from a blank page. TextOS formulates candidate questions from traced sources, and each one is measured only after a person has retained and approved it. The demand figures attached to a question come from imported, dated sources, and TextOS is explicit that they are not a measure of real traffic. Approving the questions and launching their measurement form one single, indivisible step in TextOS. The result is a list you can read, question by question, before a single answer is collected.
